## AAC Admin Command Boundary

Private webhook called only by the Cloudflare Worker. Attach a Header Auth credential that validates `X-AAC-Admin-Secret`, plus the existing BigQuery credential.

Campaign launch remains TEST001-only. It supports existing test users or an isolated presentation/demo cohort of up to 50 recipients, exactly three topics with approved central image records, and immediate, ten-minute, or scheduled invitation release. Presentation recipients use `doctor_demo_...` aliases so production doctor identities are not overwritten.

Scheduled campaigns remain `SCHEDULED` until the invitation dispatcher releases them at or after `invitation_send_at`. Presentation/demo campaigns are also marked `preview_only = TRUE`, so interview completion is stored but article generation is blocked.

Commands are idempotent, state-checked, and audited before n8n continues orchestration.

Presentation demo campaigns set marketing approval to false so a group demo can test interview, article generation, and doctor review without flooding the marketing-review recipients or auto-publishing.
